claims: Artemis II is a crewed lunar mission.
Artemis II is scheduled for no earlier than April 1, 2026, from Launch Pad 39B.
Artemis II (NASA SLS/Orion) is scheduled for April 1, 2026 (6:24 PM ET) from Kennedy Space Center Pad 39B.
ViaSat-3 F3 (SpaceX) is scheduled for April 2026 from Kennedy Space Center.
Griffin Mission One (SpaceX Falcon Heavy) is scheduled for July 2026 (TBD) from Kennedy Space Center.
Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope (SpaceX) is scheduled for September 2026 (TBD) from Kennedy Space Center.
Only spectators with specialized Artemis II Launch Viewing Packages can enter the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex on the designated launch days.
SpaceX conducts regular Starlink, commercial, and NASA cargo/crew launches from LC-39A (KSC) and SLC-40 (Cape Canaveral).
Blue Origin is developing New Glenn for future launches.
United Launch Alliance launches from SLC-41 (Cape Canaveral).
